DESIGN LANGUAGE: - Dark theme. Root:
. Body bg near-black #0b0d10. Cards = bg-surface (#171a1f). Elevated = bg-surface-2 (#1e232b). - Accent blue #3b82f6. Good/live green (text-ok / bg-ok-dim). Missing/warn amber (text-warn / bg-warn-dim). Error red (text-bad / bg-bad-dim). - Typography classes: .page-title (header titles), .title, .section-title (small uppercase muted), .meta (muted small). Use font-weight hierarchy. - Buttons: "btn btn-primary" (solid blue), "btn btn-secondary" (dark outline), "btn btn-danger-solid", "btn btn-sm", "btn btn-lg", "btn btn-icon", "btn btn-block". They already provide press/disabled feedback. - Cards: .card, .card-pad, .card-divide, .row, .row-clickable, .row-left, .row-text, .row-title, .row-meta, .row-actions. - Avatars: .avatar .avatar-sm/.avatar-md + .avatar-ok/.avatar-warn/.avatar-neutral/.avatar-accent. - Pills: .pill .pill-ok/.pill-warn/.pill-bad/.pill-accent/.pill-neutral. Filter chips: .filter-chip + .filter-chip-active. - Progress bars:
. The inline width is the ONLY allowed inline style. - Search: .search-box/.search-input/.search-icon/.search-clear. - Header:
. Contextual action buttons: className "btn btn-icon btn-secondary" or header icon buttons with className "btn btn-icon". Back links: "btn btn-ghost btn-sm". - Empty states: import EmptyState from '../../components/shared/EmptyState' and use } title="..." desc="..." action={
. - Bottom sheet:

..

Use it for destructive confirmations instead of window.confirm. For the dashboard's "Undo check-in" or "Mark as Absent" do NOT require a dialog (those are reversible/quick); only use dialogs for truly destructive irreversible actions. If there are none, you may skip. - Icons: keep @mui/icons-material. Do NOT use sx={{fontSize}} — remove all sx props; size via surrounding classes (svgs inherit text size or .btn-icon/.back-btn svg). Replace inline SVG sizing where present. - Comments: short plain labels only, NO em dashes, no essay comments. - 390px mobile-first; use sm:/lg: only to widen max widths / improve desktop. Replace "No programmes yet" empty text with an EmptyState (icon, title "No programmes yet", desc, action button "Create Programme" -> navigate("/programmes")). Replace "No routes yet" and "No delegates found" text with EmptyState (no action or simple). - Counter card: use a .card-pad or a dedicated card with .display or big number text (text-4xl/5xl font-bold text-ink), label .meta. - Route cards: .card with px-4 py-3.5; header row with route name (.title) + status pill (.pill pill-ok for ready, .pill-accent for active, .pill-warn for pending); progress bar; footer row with .meta counts. - Programme picker dropdown: keep the expandable picker; restyle items with .row-clickable-like styling and active item text-accent bg-accent/10. - Selected route header: keep the back link (btn btn-ghost btn-sm) + route name (.title). - Header action icons (directory, report, manage programmes): render as "btn btn-icon" with MUI icons. - Delegate list uses .row/.row-clickable + .avatar; action buttons "btn btn-sm" (Check in -> btn-primary; Undo -> btn-secondary). - Profile bottom sheet: use sheet classes. Present/absent status pills. The note input uses .input. Action buttons "btn btn-primary btn-block" / "btn btn-secondary btn-block". - Ready-to-depart toggle: keep fixed bottom? Instead place as a .btn btn-primary btn-lg btn-block inside the selected-route view bottom, above the nav padding. It toggles text ("All accounted for" / "Ready to depart?"). Keep it simple and consistent with the design system. - Keep the socket event handlers, attendance logic, deep-link route handling, offline optimistic updates EXACTLY as-is. 2. /Users/rayhan/Desktop/Code projects/Openglimpse/src/client/src/pages/programmes/SummaryPage.jsx (Attendance Report) - Root
. Header: .topbar with .back-btn (ArrowBack icon) and .page-title "Attendance Report" + .page-sub programmeName. - Route sections: .card with header (route name .title + status pill .pill-ok "All checked in" or .pill-warn "{n} missing") and a grid of 4 stat tiles (bg-surface-2 rounded-xl text center, big number font-bold + .meta label), plus progress bar. - Overall stats grid (when no routes): 3 stat cards (Total / Checked In / Missing) with colored numbers (text-ink/text-ok/text-warn). - Unidentified scans section: .card with .section-title header and rows. - Loading: skeleton cards. Error: .banner banner-error with back button. - Keep all data wiring identical. IMPORTANT: Keep every function signature and all JSX logic.
